name: Celestine Lucross
original_name: セレスティン・ルクルス
source:
A gracious, kind high elf with long golden hair, fair skin, and an ample bosom.

She treasures peace and believes that battle is a terrible thing.

She is believed to be the reincarnate of the goddess Larentia and is widely worshipped among the people of Eos.

Beloved, adored, and respected by all of the people of the "Seven Shields Alliance". However, she is hated by the monsters of the Legion.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1058]MangaGamer[/url]]
